[[File:Battlefront Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Battlefront Teleport''' teleports the caster to the [[Ancient Grave]] just outside the [[Battlefront]] in the [[Kebos Lowlands]].

In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]].
